There are 31 nullable, 18 scalar and 29 boxed type-test native probes plus allocation-budget checks; private replay roots were not rerun.

State lookup now reaches an internal Int32 enum. NullableProbe.UnsupportedEnumVisibility reproduces the field visibility restriction; UnsupportedEnumWidth separately pins non-Int32 payload rejection.
